clue.text: Brilliant quality of interpretation

definitions.meaning: a lustrous shine or sheen on a surface
an explanatory comment or note on a text

explanation.surface: A critic praises the brilliance of a performer's reading of a role.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a polished shine and a marginal explanation of a difficult text.

clue.text: Pleased with the weight of the bag

parts.note: pleased means glad
a stone is a British unit of weight, fourteen pounds

explanation.surface: Someone is happy with how heavy their bag turned out to be.
explanation.definitionFit: A Gladstone is a hinged leather travelling bag named after the Victorian prime minister.

clue.text: No point in worker being fat

parts.note: O, the zero shape, stands for nothing or no

indicators.note: in tells us the compass point sits inside the word for worker

parts.note: a worker bee, the crossword's usual worker
S, south, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A complaint that an idle employee has grown overweight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Point' is a compass point here, not a purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: Obese is the clinical word for being very overweight.

clue.text: Just a little bit of misgiving

definitions.meaning: a tiny apothecaries' weight of twenty grains

explanation.surface: Someone admits to having only a slight doubt.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an old tiny unit of weight and a qualm of conscience.

clue.text: Animal's limb badly in trouble.

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', so the definition reads 'Animal is'

parts.note: an arm is a limb

indicators.note: in places the word for badly inside the word for trouble

parts.note: ado means fuss or trouble
ill means badly, as in ill-treated

explanation.surface: A creature has hurt its leg and is in a bad way.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Animal's' is 'is', linking the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The armadillo is an armoured South American mammal.

clue.text: Loose maul with Northern Ireland Old Boys

indicators.note: loose suggests the letters of maul are set free and rearranged

explanation.surface: A rugby report: a loose maul involving a Northern Irish old boys' side.
explanation.walkthrough: A maul is a rugby scrum-like tussle, which suits the old boys' team picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Alumni are former pupils of a school, what British schools call Old Boys.

clue.text: Make wrong use of Defence Department's request

parts.note: MI, Military Intelligence, a defence department, with its 's
to apply is to make a formal request

explanation.surface: A complaint that the Ministry of Defence's request was abused.
explanation.walkthrough: MI (Military Intelligence) plus the possessive S gives MIS.
explanation.definitionFit: To misapply something is to put it to an improper purpose.

clue.text: French philosopher died in torment? Nonsense

indicators.note: being in torment suggests the letters of died are twisted out of shape

parts.note: rot means nonsense

explanation.surface: A claim that a French thinker died in agony is dismissed as rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Denis Diderot was the eighteenth-century French thinker who edited the Encyclopédie.

clue.text: At dinner it passes as a token of fellowship

definitions.text: At dinner it passes as a token of fellowship

parts.words: At dinner it passes as a token of fellowship
parts.note: describes a shared two-handled vessel of wine handed round the table at a formal banquet

explanation.definitionFit: A loving cup is a large shared drinking vessel passed from guest to guest at ceremonial dinners.

clue.text: Tanker's new role embraces Iran initially

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', so the definition reads 'Tanker is'

indicators.note: embraces means the rearranged letters hold the next letter inside them
new suggests the letters of role are made into a fresh arrangement
initially picks the opening letter of the word Iran

explanation.surface: A tanker has taken on a new role that involves Iran.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns ROLE into OLER, which 'embraces' the I from 'Iran initially'.
explanation.definitionFit: An oiler is a ship that carries oil, a tanker.

clue.text: Contemporary brackets for example in silver auctions in Scotland

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
roup is the Scots word for an auction sale

explanation.surface: Peer groups are categorised, for instance among buyers at Scottish silver auctions.
explanation.walkthrough: ROUP is a Scots word for an auction, unfamiliar outside Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Age groups are bands of people of similar age, so contemporaries grouped together.

clue.text: Backing existed for junior counsel

indicators.note: backing tells us the word for existed is read from back to front

parts.note: existed means lived

explanation.surface: A barrister supporting a living case for a junior lawyer.
explanation.walkthrough: In British legal slang a devil is a junior barrister who does work for a senior.
explanation.definitionFit: A devil is a junior barrister who works for another, often unpaid.

clue.text: But he hasn't retired from the firm

definitions.text: But he hasn't retired from the firm

parts.words: But he hasn't retired from the firm
parts.note: retired suggests going to bed: this investor is a slumberer yet still holds a stake in the business

explanation.definitionFit: A sleeping partner invests in a business without taking an active role in running it.

clue.text: Extra-plump victim of predator

parts.note: OS, outsize, is the clothing label for extra-large
prey is a victim of hunting

explanation.surface: An overweight creature falls victim to a hunter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'predator' looks part of 'victim of predator' but is the definition; OS is the clothes-size label outsize.
explanation.definitionFit: The osprey is a fish-eating bird of prey.

clue.text: Letter from Greece recently suggesting this hobby?

parts.note: phi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
lately means recently

explanation.surface: A recent letter from Greece hints at what someone collects.
explanation.walkthrough: The letter from Greece suits stamp collecting, since such a letter would carry a foreign stamp.
explanation.definitionFit: Philately is the collecting and study of postage stamps.

clue.text: One of the overheads material to farm policy

parts.note: cloth is material
CAP is the European Union's Common Agricultural Policy

explanation.surface: A business's overheads include a material expense tied to agricultural policy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Overheads' suggests business costs but means things worn on the head; a cloth cap is a flat working man's cap.
explanation.definitionFit: A cloth cap is a flat woollen hat, one item of headwear.

clue.text: Write boy's name in Thackeray's history book

parts.note: to pen is to write
Dennis is a boy's name

explanation.surface: Instructions to write a character's name into a Thackeray novel.
explanation.definitionFit: The History of Pendennis is a novel by William Makepeace Thackeray.

clue.text: Forged document admitting liability held by football club

indicators.note: held by puts the debt note inside the club's name

parts.note: Spurs is the nickname of Tottenham Hotspur, a London football club
an IOU is a written acknowledgement of a debt

explanation.surface: A football club is found holding a fake document admitting it owes money.
explanation.walkthrough: SPURS is Tottenham Hotspur, a London football club.
explanation.definitionFit: Spurious means fake or counterfeit, not genuine.

clue.text: One enters record range, of projector

indicators.note: enters says the numeral goes inside the run of letters

parts.note: EP, extended play, is a type of record
scope means range
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone enters the record range of a projector.
explanation.definitionFit: An episcope is an optical device that throws an image of an opaque object onto a screen.

clue.text: US diamond man gets a haul on East River

parts.note: a catch is a haul, as of fish

explanation.surface: An American jeweller lands a haul on the East River in New York.
explanation.walkthrough: The diamond is a baseball field, not a gem; the catcher crouches behind home plate.
explanation.definitionFit: In baseball the catcher is the fielder behind home plate on the diamond.

clue.text: Trap employed by head surgeon

definitions.meaning: an old verb meaning to ensnare or lure
a cylindrical saw used to cut a hole in the skull

explanation.surface: A trap is set by a chief surgeon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head surgeon' suggests a senior doctor but means one operating on the head.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an archaic verb for ensnare and a surgical saw for boring into the skull.

clue.text: Producer finally leaves badly arranged displays

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of the word Producer
badly arranged signals that the letters of leaves are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A producer at last leaves, having arranged some displays poorly.
explanation.definitionFit: Displays and reveals both mean shows or exposes to view.

clue.text: A spirit, nothing more, beloved of Mariana

parts.note: an angel is a spirit
O stands for nothing, zero

explanation.surface: Someone's beloved is described as a spirit and nothing more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'more' signals that the nothing is added on. Mariana is the jilted lover in Shakespeare's Measure for Measure.
explanation.definitionFit: In Measure for Measure Angelo is the deputy who abandoned his betrothed Mariana.

clue.text: For a place-seeker this is just what's wanted

definitions.text: For a place-seeker this is just what's wanted

parts.words: For a place-seeker this is just what's wanted
parts.note: place-seeker suggests an ambitious job-hunter, but means someone trying to find a passage in a book

explanation.definitionFit: Chapter and verse is a precise reference, originally to a passage in the Bible.

clue.text: Material result of bankruptcy

definitions.meaning: a coarse linen or cotton fabric

explanation.surface: A material consequence of going bust.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a coarse cloth used for towels and a sudden business collapse.

clue.text: Animal has one horn damaged

indicators.note: has means the shuffled letters hold the numeral inside them
damaged suggests the letters of horn are knocked out of order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A creature with only one horn, and that one damaged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'damaged' turns HORN into RHNO, which 'has' I within it.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhino, short for rhinoceros, is a large horned African or Asian mammal.

clue.text: Letter in Hebrew a help, in translation

indicators.note: in translation suggests the letters of a help are carried over into a new form

explanation.surface: A translation from Hebrew helps with a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Aleph is the first letter of the Hebrew alphabet.

clue.text: Action in the theatre

parts.note: theatre suggests a stage play but means the room where surgeons work

explanation.definitionFit: Surgery is performed in an operating theatre, and each procedure there has this name.

clue.text: To and behold, he joins battle with Tobias, without prejudice

parts.note: Ypres in Belgium was the site of several First World War battles

indicators.note: without says the word for prejudice is taken out of the name Tobias

parts.note: bias means prejudice

explanation.surface: Someone joins a fight alongside Tobias with an open mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without prejudice' sounds like legal jargon but removes BIAS from TOBIAS, leaving TO.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are exclamations announcing a surprising appearance, as a conjuror might cry.

clue.text: Puts the finger on what fleas do in a ship

indicators.note: in places the fleas' action inside the abbreviation for a ship

parts.note: SS, steamship, is the prefix for a ship
fleas hop

explanation.surface: Someone identifies what the fleas get up to aboard a vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Puts the finger on' means informs on, in slang.
explanation.definitionFit: To shop someone is British slang for informing on them to the police.
